meta.name: hunt-brute-force
meta.description: Hunt Missing/Weak Rate Limiting — login brute force, OTP/2FA brute force (10^6 keyspace), password-reset-token brute, credential stuffing, username/email enumeration via error-string / status-code / timing differences, weak password policy, missing CAPTCHA, IP-based rate-limit bypass via X-Forwarded-For and friends, ReDoS. Distinguishes hard lockout vs soft IP-throttle vs CAPTCHA-injection vs silent shadow-throttling (avoids false-negative 'no rate limit' conclusions). Medium to Critical depending on what the brute reaches (OTP→ATO = Critical).

copy.tagline: 检测并绕过登录暴力破解与限速漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要测试应用对暴力破解和限速机制的防护能力。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and bypass brute force and rate limiting vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test your app's protection against brute force and rate limiting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你测试网站登录、验证码、密码重置等接口是否存在暴力破解漏洞，并区分四种限流状态（硬锁定、软限速、验证码注入、静默限流），避免误报。
howto.when: 当你要求检查某个网站或API的暴力破解防护、限流机制、枚举漏洞时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个登录接口有没有限流
say.note: Claude 会指导你发送50次请求并分析响应。

say.text: 检查OTP验证接口是否存在暴力破解风险
say.note: Claude 会演示如何发送101个验证码并观察是否被限流。

say.text: 看看这个忘记密码接口能否枚举用户名
say.note: Claude 会教你用有效和无效邮箱对比响应差异。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you test login, OTP, password reset, and other endpoints for brute-force vulnerabilities, distinguishing four rate-limiting states (hard lockout, soft throttle, CAPTCHA injection, shadow throttle) to avoid false negatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to check a website or API for brute-force protection, rate limiting, or enumeration vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Test this login endpoint for rate limiting.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to send 50 requests and analyze responses.

say_en.text: Check if the OTP verification endpoint is vulnerable to brute force.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate sending 101 codes and observing rate limiting.

say_en.text: See if this forgot-password endpoint allows username enumeration.
say_en.note: Claude will teach you to compare responses for valid vs invalid emails.
